summary.name: Sloth
summary.one_liner: Sloth is a tool/library that standardizes generating SLOs for Prometheus, described here through Mattermost's account of using it for SLI monitoring and multi-window, multi-burn-rate SLO alerting.
use_cases: Generating SLO recording and alert rules for Prometheus
Setting up burn-rate based paging and warning alerts
Automating SLIs/SLOs per tenant or workspace from a provisioner
summary.what_it_does: Sloth is a tool/library that standardizes and simplifies generating SLOs for Prometheus. In Mattermost's deployment it was integrated as a library into their cloud provisioner so that SLIs and SLOs are created when a workspace is created or woken, and the related PrometheusRule is removed when a workspace is hibernated or deleted. Mattermost used an error-rate availability SLI built from Prometheus request counters. Sloth's built-in alert generation was disabled in favor of centralized catchall alerts in Thanos ruler, which send to Alertmanager, Grafana, and OpsGenie. The team followed the multi-window, multi-burn-rate alerting approach from the Google SRE Workbook.
notable: Generates SLO rules for Prometheus; used by Mattermost as a library inside its cloud provisioner
Multi-window, multi-burn-rate alerts: pages on fast budget burn, notifications on slow burn
Mattermost disabled Sloth's default alert generation in favor of centralized Thanos ruler catchall alerts
caveats: The page is a case study from Mattermost and does not give Sloth's own feature list, license, or pricing
Latency SLIs were described as future work and not yet in place
